evidence.description: Accessing a global singleton via EcosiaEnvironment.current

candidates.explanation: The `fetchAndUpdate` method accesses `EcosiaEnvironment.current` directly, which is a global singleton access. This creates an implicit dependency that is not supplied through an explicit dependency boundary like constructor injection.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: Async method modifying mutable instance state without isolation

candidates.explanation: The `fetchAndUpdate` method is an `async` function that modifies multiple mutable instance properties (e.g., `treesPlanted`, `timePerTree`) without any visible actor isolation, global-actor isolation, or synchronization mechanisms to prevent data races.
candidates.title: Improper Isolation of Shared Mutable State
